“What I couldn’t check” comes from what was actually looked at: general knowledge, saved facts, unmatched words, missing calendar, cut lists, replaced wording and tool output

Save to brain is a proposal with an editable title; edits void the earlier approval; it writes a new note (never overwrites), the note is searchable at once, Undo removes it, and an edited note is never deleted
